newsitem.title: USA: Female Health completes private placement.
newsitem.headline: Female Health completes private placement.

text.p: Female Health Co said on Tuesday it completed a private placement of $2.0 million in 8 percent convertible debentures due in 1999.
The debentures may be converted into common stock at the market price on the date of close or at 80 percent of the market price on the date of conversion, whichever is less.
Funds from the placement will be used for the commercial development of the female condom and pre-paying short-term debt, it added.
Female Health owns the worldwide rights to the female condom including patents that have been issued in the United States, Japan, European Union, Peoples' Republic of China, Canada and Australia.
Female Health also said that the United Nations Program on AIDS (UNAIDS) in a letter to 193 country affiliates has solicited interest in and requested intended purchase volume for the female condom.
The company said it agreed to provide a public sector price for all countries, based on worldwide demand.
In addition, UNAIDS and Female Health have agreed to collaborate in exploring ways to reduce the cost of the female condom to the public sector, the company said.
